## Activity

During February 2026, Central Eye Clinic recorded 174 captures. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the month. The recorded capture volume should be used for routine monitoring of service activity and to support review of workload and reporting processes.

## Image quality

Of the 174 captures, 5 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.9. These images could not be used for grading and should be considered in the clinic’s ongoing quality review. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

There were 54 referable results during February 2026. The median grading lag was 1 day. This provides a measure of the time between image capture and completion of grading. The clinic should continue to monitor grading activity alongside image quality and referable results, ensuring that any recurring operational issues are recorded and followed up through established channels.
